dv: held-out skill-over-mean R^2, LOCO 50 folds, closed-form ridge with nested-CV lambda, PCA-48 targets; each bar at its own best layer

span_definitions.context: templated prompt tokens only; the boundary read is ctx_last = the final prompt token (the assistant-header newline)

comparability.same_cell_family: bars 2/3/5 — boundary/mean, same model, same rollouts, all peaking at layer 6; strictly comparable
comparability.reference_bar: bar 1 is a different model and run (#810); #928 registers it as QUALITATIVE parity — answer span and generation cap differ (parent 512 new tokens, thinking model 8,192)
comparability.offscale_bar: bar 4 predicts a STACKED CoT+answer target (a different object) AND has no boundary/mean fit banked, so it is drawn at boundary/boundary

nulls: selection-symmetric max-over-layers p95 of 1,000 context permutations; all near -0.30, so far below a 0-floor axis that no band line is drawn. boundary/mean nulls were banked only for d_parity; other arms fall back to their boundary/boundary nulls (noted per bar).
